texts.orig: PepsiCo, Inc. ('PepsiCo') held its 2023 Annual Meeting of Shareholders on May 3, 2023. For more information on the following proposals, see PepsiCo's proxy statement for the 2023 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March 21, 2023. Below are the final voting results.
texts.text: PepsiCo, Inc. ('PepsiCo') held its 2023 Annual Meeting of Shareholders on May 3, 2023. For more information on the following proposals, see PepsiCo's proxy statement for the 2023 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March 21, 2023. Below are the final voting results.
